tools.name: get_page_text
tools.description: Return the full text of one page in reading order — every speech balloon and editorial marginalia block, each with speaker, register, and verbatim quote. This is a graphic-novel adaptation of Stanisław Lem's 'In Hot Pursuit of Happiness'. All quotes are verbatim text from the Michael Kandel translation.
